title: Exponential Population Growth and Carrying Capacity
description: Classic MIT DYNAMO logistic population model with crowding-dependent birth rate lookup table (TABHL) and carrying capacity feedback.
code:
NOTE LOGISTIC POPULATION GROWTH WITH CARRYING CAPACITY
* MIT DYNAMO SYSTEM DYNAMICS MODEL
L POP.K=POP.J+(DT)*(BIRTH.JK-DEATH.JK)
N POP=1000
R BIRTH.KL=POP.K*BR.K
R DEATH.KL=POP.K*DR
A BR.K=TABHL(BRTAB,CROWD.K,0,2,0.5)
A CROWD.K=POP.K/CAP
S NETGR.K=BIRTH.JK-DEATH.JK
C DR=0.02, CAP=10000
T BRTAB=0.06/0.05/0.035/0.02/0.01
SPEC DT=0.25/LENGTH=80/PRTPER=5/PLTPER=2
PRINT POP,BIRTH,DEATH,CROWD
PLOT POP=P(0,12000)/BIRTH=B
RUN BASE

title: Inventory-Workforce Supply Chain Oscillation
description: Forrester industrial dynamics production-inventory-workforce loop exhibiting damped inventory cycles in response to a step increase in customer orders.
code:
NOTE FORRESTER INVENTORY-WORKFORCE SUPPLY CHAIN OSCILLATION
L INV.K=INV.J+(DT)*(PROD.JK-SHIP.JK)
N INV=400
L WORK.K=WORK.J+(DT)*(HIRE.JK)
N WORK=20
R PROD.KL=WORK.K*PRODW
R SHIP.KL=DEMAND.K
R HIRE.KL=(DWORK.K-WORK.K)/THIRE
A DEMAND.K=BASEDEM+STEP(20,5)
A DINV.K=DEMAND.K*ICOV
A DPROD.K=DEMAND.K+(DINV.K-INV.K)/TINV
A DWORK.K=DPROD.K/PRODW
C PRODW=5, BASEDEM=100, ICOV=4, TINV=6, THIRE=8
SPEC DT=0.25/LENGTH=60/PRTPER=4/PLTPER=2
PRINT INV,WORK,PROD,SHIP
PLOT INV=I(0,800)/WORK=W(0,40)
RUN STEP_DEMAND

title: Bass New-Product Diffusion Market Adoption
description: Two-stock Bass market diffusion model coupling advertising-driven innovation with word-of-mouth social imitation across a fixed addressable market.
code:
NOTE BASS NEW-PRODUCT DIFFUSION MARKET ADOPTION MODEL
L POT.K=POT.J+(DT)*(-ADOPT.JK)
N POT=100000
L ADOPTERS.K=ADOPTERS.J+(DT)*(ADOPT.JK)
N ADOPTERS=0
R ADOPT.KL=AD_ADOPT.K+WOM_ADOPT.K
A AD_ADOPT.K=POT.K*P_ADV
A WOM_ADOPT.K=CONTACT*FRAC_AD.K*POT.K*ADOPTERS.K/TMKT
A FRAC_AD.K=Q_WOM
A PENET.K=ADOPTERS.K/TMKT
C TMKT=100000, P_ADV=0.015, Q_WOM=0.08, CONTACT=5
SPEC DT=0.125/LENGTH=20/PRTPER=1/PLTPER=0.5
PRINT POT,ADOPTERS,ADOPT,PENET
PLOT ADOPTERS=A(0,100000)/ADOPT=R(0,15000)
RUN LAUNCH

title: SIR Epidemic with Behavioral Feedback Delay
description: Compartmental Susceptible-Infectious-Recovered (SIR) epidemic model with third-order information delay (DELAY3) modulating contact rate as perceived prevalence rises.
code:
NOTE SIR EPIDEMIC MODEL WITH BEHAVIORAL PERCEPTION DELAY
L SUSC.K=SUSC.J+(DT)*(-INFECT.JK)
N SUSC=9990
L INF.K=INF.J+(DT)*(INFECT.JK-RECOV.JK)
N INF=10
L REC.K=REC.J+(DT)*(RECOV.JK)
N REC=0
R INFECT.KL=CONT_EFF.K*BETA*SUSC.K*INF.K/NTOT
R RECOV.KL=INF.K/DUR
A PREV.K=INF.K/NTOT
A PERC_PREV.K=DELAY3(PREV.K,TDEL)
A CONT_EFF.K=TABHL(CTAB,PERC_PREV.K,0,0.2,0.05)
A R_EFF.K=CONT_EFF.K*BETA*DUR*SUSC.K/NTOT
C NTOT=10000, BETA=0.08, DUR=7, TDEL=5
T CTAB=10/7.5/5.0/3.2/2.0
SPEC DT=0.25/LENGTH=120/PRTPER=10/PLTPER=4
PRINT SUSC,INF,REC,R_EFF
PLOT SUSC=S(0,10000)/INF=I(0,4000)/REC=R(0,10000)
RUN EPIDEMIC

title: World3-Inspired Resource-Capital-Pollution System Dynamics
description: Coupled four-sector Meadows World3-style global dynamics model linking industrial capital, nonrenewable resources, persistent pollution, and population mortality feedback.
code:
NOTE WORLD3-INSPIRED RESOURCE-CAPITAL-POLLUTION COUPLED SYSTEM DYNAMICS
L POP.K=POP.J+(DT)*(BIRTH.JK-DEATH.JK)
N POP=3000
L CAP.K=CAP.J+(DT)*(INVEST.JK-DEPREC.JK)
N CAP=600
L RES.K=RES.J+(DT)*(-USE.JK)
N RES=100000
L POL.K=POL.J+(DT)*(POLGEN.JK-POLABS.JK)
N POL=50
R BIRTH.KL=POP.K*BR_NORM*BMULT.K
R DEATH.KL=POP.K*DR_NORM*DMULT.K
R INVEST.KL=OUTPUT.K*INVFRAC
R DEPREC.KL=CAP.K/CAPLIFE
R USE.KL=OUTPUT.K*RESINT
R POLGEN.KL=OUTPUT.K*POLINT
R POLABS.KL=POL.K/POLTIME
A RESFRAC.K=RES.K/RES0
A RESMULT.K=TABHL(RMULT,RESFRAC.K,0,1,0.25)
A OUTPUT.K=CAP.K*CAP_PROD*RESMULT.K
A OUT_PC.K=OUTPUT.K/POP.K
A POLRATIO.K=POL.K/POL0
A BMULT.K=TABHL(BTAB,OUT_PC.K,0,1,0.25)
A DMULT.K=TABHL(DTAB,POLRATIO.K,0,10,2.5)
C BR_NORM=0.032, DR_NORM=0.014, INVFRAC=0.22, CAPLIFE=15
C CAP_PROD=0.35, RESINT=0.8, POLINT=0.04, POLTIME=10
C RES0=100000, POL0=50
T RMULT=0.05/0.35/0.70/0.92/1.00
T BTAB=1.20/1.05/0.85/0.65/0.55
T DTAB=0.90/1.05/1.35/1.85/2.60
SPEC DT=0.5/LENGTH=150/PRTPER=10/PLTPER=5
PRINT POP,CAP,RES,POL,OUTPUT
PLOT POP=P(0,12000)/CAP=C(0,4000)/POL=X(0,1000)
RUN STANDARD_RUN
